newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 8.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The People's Bank of China, the central bank, will take a series of measures to improve services to major state enterprises including offering more loans to well-run, highly-profitable companies.
- Some brokerages in Beijing have stopped opening new accounts due to the numbers of stock investors and this has caused blackmarket trading in existing accounts.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Several banks have applied to start off-shore finance business in Shanghai to allow foreigners in China to trade outside the country.
